samples.content:

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    values = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    
    k = n // 2
    # Use quickselect to partially sort, similar to partial_sort
    values.sort()
    print(values[k])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
